title: Waterfall API FAQ
snippet: API access is available by approval. Enter your work email on the [Waterfall website](https://www.waterfall.io/) to request a key, or [book a call](https://www.waterfall.io/book-a-call) to discuss your workflow and pricing. A member of our team reviews every access request; we aim to reply within a couple of hours. We work with a limited number of customers so we can provide direct support and plan capacity around each team’s needs. Once you have a key, send it in the `x-api-key` header. Follow [Authentication](/v1/authentication) and the [Quickstart](/v1/quickstart).

title: Get API access
snippet:
API access is available by approval. Request a key through the email field on the [Waterfall website](https://www.waterfall.io/), or book a call to discuss your workflow. A member of our team reviews every access request. We aim to reply within a couple of hours.
## Request an API key
Enter your work email on our homepage to request access.
## Book a call
Talk through your use case, pricing, and integration with our team.
We work with a limited number of customers so we can provide direct support and plan capacity around each team’s needs. Before enabling access, we take time to understand what you are building, the data you need, and your expected volume. Customers get a dedicated channel with our founders for questions and integration help. You can also email [support@waterfall.io](mailto:support@waterfall.io). For a useful first conversation, share your use case, input types, expected request volume, and required outputs. For a technical issue, include the endpoint, error code, and any known job ID. Keep API keys out of your message. Before the call, explore [use cases](/v1/use-cases/overview), [compare APIs](/v1/introduction), or prepare a sample using the [evaluation guide](/v1/evaluate-waterfall).

title: About Waterfall
snippet:
Waterfall has undergone a SOC 2 Type II audit covering Security, Confidentiality, and Privacy. Our penetration tests are conducted by independent auditors who also work with Snowflake and T-Mobile. Our infrastructure runs on AWS, with encryption in transit and at rest. We use the data you submit to the API to fulfil your requests. We do not resell those inputs, repurpose them for other customers, or add them to a shared enrichment database. [Contact our team](mailto:support@waterfall.io) for audit scope and security documentation.

API access is available by approval. We review each request individually and work with a limited number of customers so we can provide direct support and plan capacity around each team’s needs. When you work with Waterfall, you get a dedicated channel with our founders. Ask questions, share what you are building, and work directly with us on API selection, integration, benchmarks, and custom data pipelines.

- [Talk to the team](mailto:support@waterfall.io) about your use case, API access, and pricing.
